displayName: Selection Info – Detailed analysis of selected text
description:
Provides comprehensive information about selected text with multiple shortcut keys, each supporting multiple presses to cycle through features.

Shortcuts:
• Ctrl+Shift+A – Character count (1st press), word count (2nd), line count (3rd)
• Ctrl+Shift+Q – Sentence count (1st), longest and shortest words (2nd), number/digit count (3rd)
• Ctrl+Shift+E – Copy to clipboard (1st), selected emails count (2nd), selection info (3rd), save to file (4th)
• Ctrl+Shift+R – Copy only digits from selection
• Ctrl+Shift+Y – Maths calculations: addition (1st), subtraction (2nd), multiplication (3rd), division (4th)
• Ctrl+Shift+F – Announce and copy the last maths result
• Ctrl+Shift+O – Extract URLs (1st), open extracted URLs in browser (2nd)
• Ctrl+Shift+V – Play/stop voice guide (audio file must be present)

All features can be enabled/disabled in NVDA Settings → Selection Info.
Double‑press timeout and auto‑save location are also configurable.
Author: Kasturi Bhosale
Minimum NVDA version: 2023, last tested: 2026.1
changelog:
Initial release.
All core features implemented:
- Text statistics (characters, words, lines, sentences, longest/shortest words, number count)
- Clipboard copy, save to file, and selection info summary
- Email selection count (Outlook, Gmail, Outlook Web)
- Maths calculations (add, subtract, multiply, divide)
- URL extraction and opening
- Copy digits only
- Voice guide for all commands
- Fully configurable settings panel
